name: Croissoar
look: a plump dough-coloured pig gliding under a great arched paraglider of layered golden croissant dough, its pale tied ears standing up like wings
entry: Its blanket of dough rises and bakes into a great flaky paraglider. It leaps off hilltops and rides the warm air for miles, steering with its ears, and leaves a trail of buttery crumbs behind it.
how: Evolve Wrapiglet at level 26. It learns Gust when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in hills, plains and highlands.
